about-info-1: Hello, I am Trần Trung Hậu. I graduated with an Information Technology degree, focusing on software engineering, web application development, and system analysis. My tech journey began with foundational web technologies, and I have since cultivated a versatile skill set across frontend, backend, and full software development lifecycles.
about-info-2: I consider myself a self-taught, detail-oriented engineer who is constantly exploring new technologies, software architectural patterns, and development methodologies to build practical and scalable systems.
about-info-3: Alongside programming, I have hands-on experience in business analysis, quality assurance, and system workflow modeling. This enables me to understand not only how to write clean code, but also how software directly serves user needs and business goals.

about-skills-9: Practical knowledge of version control, collaborative Git workflows, and CI/CD deployment pipelines.

services-questions-1: What is a fully responsive web application?
services-questions-p1: It is an application designed to adapt seamlessly to any device screen size—desktops, tablets, and smartphones—ensuring optimal readability and user experience.
services-questions-2: How do you approach a new software project?
services-questions-p2: I begin by clarifying business goals, drafting workflows and data requirements, building prototypes, writing maintainable code, and testing rigorously prior to deployment.
services-questions-p3: Regular updates, bug fixes, and security patches keep applications reliable, fast, and secure as business requirements and user traffic grow.
services-questions-p4: You can reach out directly via email, LinkedIn, or GitHub. I am open to freelance projects, contract opportunities, and full-time software engineering roles.
